name: framer-to-code
description: Tools to migrate Framer-published websites into self-contained, pixel-perfect coded static sites.

plugins.name: framer-to-code
plugins.description: Convert any Framer-published website into a self-contained coded static site by pasting its URL. Two skills: a pixel-perfect mirror (keeps the localized Framer runtime), and a hard mode that removes the Framer runtime entirely (no React, pure HTML/CSS + tiny vanilla JS).
